name: Futa Futa (2) Kansui Joshi Ka Keikaku
original_name: フタふたっ(2)完遂女子化計画
source:
Kaoru, who has been demanded 500,000 yen by the hermaphrodite twins “Miyabi and Miaka,” heads back to the science prep room despite being plagued by anxiety

The twins seemed to have completely cheered up, but their devilish discipline of Kaoru escalates even further.
Unable to resist the twins—who sometimes act unreasonably and other times tempt him with sweet words—Kaoru accepts their demands as his desires lead him, but...

Standing before Kaoru, who is flaunting his genitals and begging for sex, is his kind senior, “Kondo-kun.”

Having accepted her transformation into a girl, the twins now plot to feminize Kaoru’s very soul.
Trembling at the sudden appearance of a potential boyfriend, Kaoru is anally violated by a man and falls into the depths of despair.
